An '''electrostatic gun''' was a type of energy weapon used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A large electrostatic weapon was mounted atop the [[People's Tower]] in [[New Adasta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], and was designed as a last resort against major civil uprisings. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] modified it to be non-lethal, allowing him and his allies to free New Adasta's population from [[Tenebrae|Vitiate's]] control.
